<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_ITSolutionRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/it-solution-request">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Request" name="IT solution request submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Rollout" name="Solution rolled out"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_ITSolutionRequest">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Requester" name="Employee or department (requester)" processRef="Process_Requester"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IT" name="IT" processRef="Process_IT"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SubmitRequest" name="Submit request" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Start_RequestReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RolloutNotice" name="Roll out notice" sourceRef="Task_Rollout" targetRef="Event_RolloutReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Requester" name="Requester process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Requester" name="Need for IT solution identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit request for IT solution"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_RolloutReceived" name="Solution rolled out to department">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RolloutReceived" messageRef="Msg_Rollout"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RequestCompleted" name="Request completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Req_1" sourceRef="Start_Requester" targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Req_2" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Event_RolloutReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Req_3" sourceRef="Event_RolloutReceived" targetRef="End_RequestCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_IT" name="IT process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RequestReceived" name="IT solution request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RequestReceived" messageRef="Msg_Request"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessRequest" name="Assess request for compatibility, cost and resource needs"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval_Split" name="Request approved?" default="Flow_IT_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Procure" name="Procure tools or licenses"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Install" name="Install solution"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test" name="Test solution in controlled environment"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Rollout" name="Roll out solution to requesting department" messageRef="Msg_Rollout"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FollowUp_Split" name="Post-rollout activities"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Training" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:documentation>Training may be provided.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Support" name="Provide IT support for troubleshooting"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_TrainingProvided" name="Training provided"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SupportAvailable" name="IT support available"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotApproved" name="Request not approved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IT_1" sourceRef="Start_RequestReceived" targetRef="Task_AssessRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IT_2" sourceRef="Task_AssessRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Approval_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IT_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="Task_Procure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IT_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="End_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IT_3" sourceRef="Task_Procure" targetRef="Task_Install"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IT_4" sourceRef="Task_Install" targetRef="Task_Test"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IT_5" sourceRef="Task_Test" targetRef="Task_Rollout"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IT_6" sourceRef="Task_Rollout" targetRef="Gateway_FollowUp_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IT_7" sourceRef="Gateway_FollowUp_Split" targetRef="Task_Training"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IT_8" sourceRef="Gateway_FollowUp_Split" targetRef="Task_Support"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IT_9" sourceRef="Task_Training" targetRef="End_TrainingProvided"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IT_10" sourceRef="Task_Support" targetRef="End_SupportAvailable"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
